# Mobile API for a fitness app

*Client industry: fitness | Completed: 2023-05-10 | Evidence id: fullstack:case:p13*

## The problem
The client was a mobile team blocked on an unstable backend.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using Node.js, GraphQL, a relational database with proper migrations, AWS. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project kept p95 API latency under 180 ms at launch.
